runtime_contract: getStreams(tmdbId, mediaType, season, episode) plus global SCRAPER_SETTINGS

manifest_platform_filtering.consequence: Do not rely on manifest platform fields to hide an unsafe provider from NuvioTV; the provider output itself must be strict-media safe or globally disabled.

semantic_changes_reviewed: StreamRepository adds backward-compatible forceRefresh=false and playback-time local plugin pause/resume
StreamRepositoryImpl adds session caching keyed by profile, type, videoId, season, episode and source/debrid configuration
provider executeScrapersStreaming positional tmdbId/mediaType/season/episode invocation remains unchanged
stream URL and behaviorHints/proxyHeaders ingestion remain preserved through the player path
exact current-head official TV route-reader proof reaches the production player successfully

notes: NuvioTV provider compatibility is a distinct runtime family from Nuvio Mobile and Nuvio Desktop.
The source_ref is the exact official NuvioTV commit most recently source-audited against this contract and re-proven by NiakVIO native-client tests before publication.

The 2026-08-22 audit reviewed the new search-session cache and repository interface changes; cache identity includes profile, media identity and source configuration and does not collapse distinct episode requests.
Provider extraction still uses positional getStreams and preserves returned URL/header material; playback networking continues to consume behaviorHints/proxyHeaders.
NuvioTV currently parses supportedPlatforms/disabledPlatforms in the manifest model but its PluginManager does not apply those fields when building enabled scrapers.
A zero-stream result is not by itself proof of incompatibility.
Providers blocked on every Mobile/Desktop runtime but still enabled in the shared manifest must sanitize all NuvioTV-returned URLs against real media payloads.
Promoted direct-media wrappers require strict HLS, DASH or real container evidence.
